description: This file defines the Workstation class and related functions for managing manufacturing workstations, including validation, holiday checks, and BOM updates.

classes.description: Validation error for workstation holiday issues

classes.description: Validation error when operation exceeds working hours

classes.name: Workstation

methods.name: update_bom_operation
